'''Improved Battery Capacity''' is an [[Odyssey Engineering]] modification for pilot suits. It increases the suit battery's total energy capacity by '''50%'''.<ref name="inara-rosa">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/37/ INARA: Rosa Dayette], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

The modification increases the available energy pool. It does not reduce the rate at which individual suit systems or tools consume energy.

== Compatibility and Engineers ==

Improved Battery Capacity can be installed on Artemis, [[Dominator Suit|Dominator]], and Maverick suits with an open modification slot. It is provided by:

* [[Wellington Beck]]
* [[Oden Geiger]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]

The Engineer must first be discovered, met, and unlocked. The suit and required materials must then be taken to that Engineer's workshop.

== Cost ==

The current modification recipe is:

* 5 Reactor Output Review
* 8 Maintenance Logs
* 3 Ion Battery
* 5 Micro Supercapacitor
* 5 [[Electrical Wiring]]
* 750,000 CR

Frontier reduced Odyssey Engineering recipe quantities in the 18.08 Engineering rebalance; older guides may show larger material requirements.<ref name="frontier-type8">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/type-8-update-now-available Frontier Developments: Type-8 Update is Now Available], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>

== Operational effect ==

Battery energy powers a suit's shields, life support, tools, and other active systems. Increasing capacity extends the time available before an energy-cell recharge or another power source is needed, but the gain depends on how the suit is being used.

A shielded combat suit under fire drains energy differently from an unshielded exploration suit, and sustained tool operation creates a different load again. The 50% capacity increase therefore does not translate into one fixed number of additional minutes for every activity.

== When to use it ==

Improved Battery Capacity is broadly useful across all three specialist suits:

* '''Artemis:''' extends unsupported exobiology and surface exploration away from a vehicle or building power source.
* '''Dominator:''' offsets the combat suit's smaller standard battery and supports longer periods with shields active.
* '''Maverick:''' extends settlement salvage and mission work that combines shields, the Arc Cutter, and the EnergyLink.

It competes for a limited suit modification slot. A build used mainly for tool-heavy salvage can compare it with [[Reduced Tool Battery Consumption]], which reduces drain from supported tool functions instead of enlarging the entire energy pool. Improved Battery Capacity is the more general choice when several suit systems contribute to the drain.<ref name="fandom-battery">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Improved_Battery_Capacity Elite Dangerous Wiki: Improved Battery Capacity], accessed 13 September 2026.</ref>
